cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when I put my spare key under the pot, just as you did? You told me not to clutter the doorstep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was for the plumber to collect. It wasn't meant to stay there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, ready for whoever needs it. Is your front-door key in your bag?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. It's inside, and the door's locked. Yours is still under the pot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you lift it, say whose clutter gets us in. The plumber didn't leave us a spare.

reason: Create a specific misunderstood copied action which determines how A pursues this Drive, preserving useful seed causality and giving B a concrete concern that changes the ending.
